units.source_text: 虽然只是轻描淡写，萤兵部卿亲王看了如获至宝。

en.t: Although it was written only in a light, casual way, Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, treasured it as if he had found a priceless jewel.

units.source_text: 由此可见玉鬘已经了解他的心迹，虽然只有寥寥数字，亦觉欢喜无量。

en.t: From this he could see that Tamakazura had already understood his feelings, and though her words were few, he felt boundless joy.

units.source_text: 此种来信虽然无甚要事，但各人各自申恨诉怨，花样甚多。

en.t: Letters of this kind may contain no very important business, but each person pours out private grievances and complaints in many different ways.

units.source_text: 总之，为女子者之心情，当以玉鬘为模范。

en.t: In short, for a woman's sensibility, Tamakazura ought to be taken as the model.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣与内大臣对她都如此评判。

en.t: The Genji Grand Minister and the Inner Minister both judged her in this way.
